tools.name: get_design
tools.description: Use this when you need the actual design values of one indexed site to build or restyle UI. Default returns the compact card (role colors with the site's own CSS variable names, fonts, type sizes, radius, container, caveats, links). tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Use this to answer "what font/colors/framework does <site> use?" for one site. Returns brand name, fonts with roles and weights, role colors, hues, detected stack (framework, CMS, hosting) and capture date. tools.description: Use this when you will implement from a site's design: returns the file to save into the project verbatim. format "design.md" (default) is a DESIGN.md (YAML tokens + prose, google/design.md format); "tokens.css" is CSS custom properties; "tailwind" is a Tailwind v4 @theme block; "shadcn" is the :roo

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Use this when the user likes one site and wants alternatives or neighbours: "more like Linear", "sites with Stripe's typography". tools.name: browse_by
tools.description: Use this to explore what the index contains: without `value` it lists the values of a facet with counts (e.g. every font family, every style tag); with `value` it lists the sites that have it. tools.name: compose_brief
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a direction that mixes references ("Linear's colors with Stripe's type"), or a ready-to-save brief from one site. Returns a markdown brief with exact values (role colors and site tokens, font stacks, type styles, radii, spacing, shadows, motion), caveats and source links
